issue.title: Issue finding age in months from participants.tsv for v24.0.0

summary.text: The original ValueError was reproduced and the fix guards against it with no regressions found, but Break My Fix found an input that still breaks parse_bids_for_age_months (a call with a very long bids_root string). Look at that counterexample first to see whether the long path needs handling, and note the behaviour diff was only partial.

findings.relation: the same before the fix, but the fix changed module-level code that runs when the module is imported (nibabies/utils/bids.py 290, 291), so it can't be shown untouched

survivors.description: Secondary filter condition loosened to OR, which can fail when only one of the two is provided.
survivors.diff:
--- a/nibabies/utils/bids.py
+++ b/nibabies/utils/bids.py
@@ -310,3 +310,3 @@
         # Apply secondary filter if provided
-        if secondary_column and secondary_val:
+        if secondary_column or secondary_val:
             mask = mask & (df[secondary_column] == secondary_val)
survivors.words: nibabies/utils/bids.py:311: changing `        if secondary_column and secondary_val:` to `        if secondary_column or secondary_val:` made no test fail; no input tried behaved differently from the fix (it may be equivalent)
